stories.title: The threat the H5N1 avian flu poses to Australia and New Zealand's unique wildlife
stories.summary: After killing millions of animals worldwide, the highly contagious H5N1 avian flu has arrived in Australia and New Zealand. Experts warn it could push some unique and native species to extinction.

stories.title: Strangers helped a college student get to his friend in the hospital
stories.summary: While Jake Berry was in college, he learned one of his oldest friends was in the hospital more than an hour away. Berry didn't have a car, but two strangers gave him a ride.

stories.title: Border wall expansion brings protests in national monument, other Arizona locations
stories.summary: New efforts to establish a more elaborate "smart wall" along parts of the U.S.-Mexico border are spawning protests in Arizona.

stories.title: Are you scrolling, instead of sleeping again? Here's when it may be an addiction
stories.summary: Claims that Meta made its platforms addictive are now being tested in court. But what separates a bad scrolling habit from an addiction, and what can people do about it?

stories.title: Group uncovers history by exploring sunken slave ships
stories.summary: Divers in Florida are seeking sunken slave ships for connections to history.

stories.title: An iconic mail-order music and video company is shutting down
stories.summary: The long-running mail-order business Columbia House, which became famous for its record and CD clubs before focusing on DVDs, has announced it'll take its final orders next month.
